turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: What has been on your mind since we last spoke?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I worry about everything, exams, money, my parents, and I cannot switch it off.

turns.speaker: CLINICIAN
turns.text: How long has it been like that?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Most days for about a year now. I lie awake at night going over it.
